title: contrib signal
description: GitHub contribution calendar of the gh user (gh api graphql), refreshed hourly. GET /api/signals/contrib, polled every 30 min; 404 unless providers.contrib.enabled (opt-in, uses your gh login); null until the first fetch. SENSITIVE (activity pattern).

days.description: The last 14 weeks (up to 98 days), oldest first, each a [date, count] pair.

year.description: Total contributions over the last year (GitHub's calendar total).

at.description: When it was fetched. Unix time in seconds (float).
